page.notes: Long s is normalised to plain s throughout (fcortatione, fimfon, etc.). The printed "f"-forms are read as long s. Doubtful readings: "euitari" (printed "cuitari"), "diuinctio" (print unclear), "æneus" (printed çneus), and "petere licet" (the printed text has a break at "figna petere|licet"). The "Simson" entries are read from "fimfon", "Simsonis" from "fimsonis". The final "97" is a page reference of the entry "simulachra", not a page number. The fragment at the top ("nibus confirmetur") continues from the previous page. The bottom-right mark is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed.
